notes.title: Cornhole Version 2.0.0.79 Update
notes.content:
Update to address the following:
* Redirects user to the steam store for the title if the user does not own it.
* If the user owns the other title, it closes game and loads the selected game.
* Fixed issues where camera was not working in the halls
* Various locomotion issues
